page.notes: The left edge carries mirrored show-through and fragments of the facing page, not transcribed. Several lines in the text are faint and partly obscured by show-through; the reading "Sedit ergo", "iudicium" and "impe-" follows the scan but the line ends near the bottom are uncertain. The line "son ennis est" is damaged and written as printed in the scan only approximately; "[?]" should be read there. The paragraph numbers 10 and 11 stand at the start of paragraphs in the column and are kept in the text. A catchword is not visible.
